capabilities: Ask a model about the active note or selected text
Connect to ChatGPT subscription, API-key providers, or local Ollama endpoints
Review AI-proposed vault actions before they modify notes or folders
Open ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini webviews from Obsidian
Apply clipboard vault action JSON via a command
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community directory; installed manually from GitHub releases. Includes privacy/security disclosures, a security policy, and discloses AI coding-agent assistance in its development. modify_note replaces the full file and is flagged as higher risk; absolute paths and path traversal are rejected.
motivation: The author built it around the principle that AI can suggest changes but the user keeps control of the vault, with small prompts, provider presets, and reviewed writes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, and AI tools that write to the vault often apply changes without letting the user inspect them first.

relations.evidence: uses openai-oauth, a local OpenAI-compatible proxy

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, or DeepSeek API key
Node.js and openai-oauth proxy for ChatGPT subscription mode; Ollama for local mode
ChatGPT subscription account for the proxy mode

summary: AI work panel that answers questions about the current note or selection and applies AI-proposed vault file changes only after user review.
